```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES={GPU_ID}

# C009 verify
EXPECTED_MD5="17673bf373f00f83ccc41fc1d355a4cd"
ACTUAL_MD5=$(md5sum /root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp001/evaluate.py | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$ACTUAL_MD5" = "$EXPECTED_MD5" ] || { echo "C009 FAIL: md5 mismatch"; exit 1; }

# C006 verify
ADAPTER_DIR="{ADAPTER_PATH}"
# 检查 adapter_config.json 在根目录还是 lora_adapter/ 子目录
if [ -f "$ADAPTER_DIR/adapter_config.json" ]; then
    CONFIG="$ADAPTER_DIR/adapter_config.json"
elif [ -f "$ADAPTER_DIR/lora_adapter/adapter_config.json" ]; then
    ADAPTER_DIR="$ADAPTER_DIR/lora_adapter"
    CONFIG="$ADAPTER_DIR/adapter_config.json"
else
    echo "C006 FAIL: no adapter_config.json found"; exit 1
fi
ALPHA=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('$CONFIG'))['lora_alpha'])")
[ "$ALPHA" = "32" ] || { echo "C006 FAIL: alpha=$ALPHA"; exit 1; }

cd /root/contamcal-irt-calibration
python3 exp001/evaluate.py \
    --model-path {BASE_MODEL_PATH} \
    --adapter-path "$ADAPTER_DIR" \
    --benchmarks arc_challenge \
    --batch-size 4 \
    --output-dir results/gemma-2-9b_{DOSAGE}_s42/arc_challenge/

echo "DONE: {DOSAGE} ARC accuracy:"
python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('results/gemma-2-9b_{DOSAGE}_s42/arc_challenge/results.json')); print(f'{d[\"accuracy\"]*100:.2f}%')"
```
